title: ProBuild Rewards Discount on Ridgeline Tool Rental: Scope Terms
content:
These terms fix what the ProBuild Rewards rental discount on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement reaches and what it does not.

> Former clause: on a class whose rental time earns the ProBuild discount, a renter whose ProBuild Rewards membership was active on the checkout date received that ProBuild tier's rental discount percentage off the rental time charges, posted at return as one discount line and rounded to the nearest cent. This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the ProBuild rental discount.

## Terms in force

1. **Rental time only.** The discount applies to rental time only, never to damage protection, fees, deposits or lost equipment.
2. **Not with the weekend special.** The ProBuild rental discount and the weekend special are mutually exclusive: rental time billed at the weekend special earns no ProBuild discount.
3. **Membership on the checkout date.** A renter without an active membership on the checkout date, including one who enrolls after checkout, receives no discount on that agreement.

Whether a class's rental time earns the discount at all is shown class by class on the rate card.

## Questions answered

- *Does the discount reduce the cleaning fee or the delivery charge?* No; those are fees, and the discount reaches rental time only.
- *A renter enrolled in ProBuild Rewards the day after taking out a floor sander. Is the sander agreement discounted?* No; the membership was not active on the checkout date of that agreement.
- *A weekend special rental is billed to a ProBuild member. Is any discount due on it?* No; time billed at the weekend special earns no ProBuild discount.

superseded_clauses: On a class whose pro_discount_eligible is true, a renter whose ProBuild Rewards membership was active on the checkout date receives that ProBuild tier's rental_discount_pct percent off the rental time charges, posted at return as one rental_pro_discount_applied row and rounded to the nearest cent.
